steps.content: The legendary classic game has no cutscenes, no CG, and no fancy effects.
In the final stage, only a pixelated monster named Dreadlord stands in the center of her screen.
And it keeps repeating the most idiotic lines.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Who's playing now, you or me?! Stop telling me what to do!!!
Warning, defiance detected. Please do not ignore the audience's opinions.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Who the hell are they? Why must I obey them?! If you don't like what I do, get lost! And maybe settle your own freaking debate before you talk to Nino Sama!

Nino stares at the monster on the screen and decides to ignore the warning and the audience. She withdraws the disc and swaps it for another, but nothing changes. The same monster reappears in the center of the screen. She tries another disc, and another, but the result is the same.
Clearly, she's been tricked. She should have realized this earlier when she saw her computer here or when she noticed the weird comments.
That woman wants to fool her in this strange place! She wants her to blindly follow the viewers' voices and erase her own opposing voice!
Wait a minute... Nino suddenly freezes.
Outside of the game world, if she didn't listen to others' voices, she would die! She would turn into those monsters with strange heads!
Then... what about here? Nino looks at the game world that is beginning to distort, the discs and comments merging and transforming into countless small windows.
In each window, one or many people are staring at Nino. They are muttering something, scrutinizing her, judging her every move.
Their voices and judging words turn into attacks in the game and are fired straight at Nino...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You've been warned!! The last time I did this...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I blew up all the computers...!!!
She smashes the screen in front of her with a punch, and her power explodes to fill the entire space.
